v.t: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Ps 90:4 (65 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Hab 2:3 (49 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Isa 51:6 (18 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Isa 65:17 (25 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).

v.t: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle (2 Pet 1:1).
